fusions.name: Hoof-Down Rush
fusions.desc: You charge an enemy up to 8 tiles away and strike it, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Bruised] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Trample
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Charger's Weight
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 10 seconds, and your movement speed by 25% for 10 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Drumming Hooves
fusions.desc: Every blow you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6, they all spend at once, and you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds.
